method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global markets were already fragile. Big AI bets could break them
Equities.reason: Broad macro piece framing the dominant equity narrative: concentrated AI positioning has left markets fragile. High relevance because it captures market-wide regime risk (AI concentration + liquidity/funding vulnerability) that can drive risk-off flows across equities.

Equities.title: AI Risk Needs to Clear Before Any Post-Midterm S&P Rally Begins
Equities.reason: Macro/flow-focused take that reinforces the prevailing narrative: AI trade is now a 'show-me' story and election-driven optimism may be insufficient without clarity on AI execution — net negative for near-term equity sentiment.

Equities.title: US Tech Stocks Enter Correction on AI and Midterm Election Risks
Equities.reason: Market-moving theme: tech-led correction tied explicitly to AI execution and political uncertainty. Important for equities because tech/AI leadership drives index performance and flows.

Equities.title: Nasdaq-100 tumbles into its third correction this year as AI worries mount
Equities.reason: Index-level confirmation of the tech/AI-led selloff; signals concentration risk in market leadership and weighs on headline equity indices.

Equities.title: Apple forecasts margin drop in holiday quarter as rising memory costs bite
Equities.reason: Apple is a market-cap heavyweight; a margin warning (despite strong sales) increases downside tail risk for the broader market and saps confidence in tech earnings leverage.

Equities.title: Oracle files to sell $20 billion in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
Equities.summary: Oracle filed plans on Monday to issue new shares and more debt to finance its artificial intelligence buildout.
Equities.reason: Large equity and debt issuance to fund AI capex implies potential dilution and signals firms are turning to capital markets for financing. Moderately negative for equity sentiment and liquidity backdrop.

Equities.title: Nvidia orders data centre clients to reduce China exposure
Equities.summary: World’s biggest chipmaker tells cloud computing providers a majority of their clients must be non-Chinese
Equities.reason: Company-level policy has broad market implications: de-risking China exposure by Nvidia can depress revenue growth expectations for chip/cloud ecosystem and increase geopolitical/regulatory risk premia for tech stocks.

Equities.title: Blackstone president calls for more equity to fund AI buildout as debt risks mount
Equities.reason: Signals a shift in financing mix for big AI projects toward equity amid rising debt concerns; reinforces cautious investor stance on leverage and the funding runway for large-scale AI deployments.

Equities.title: U.S. strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island as Vance hopes for ‘negotiated settlement’ with Tehran
Equities.summary: U.S. military carried out attacks on Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday, even as the Trump administration has been underplaying war risks.
Equities.reason: Escalation in the Middle East raises geopolitical risk and can trigger risk-off flows across equities, particularly energy/defense; contributes to near-term market uncertainty ahead of earnings/midterms.

Equities.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
Equities.summary: Anthropic unveiled its S-1 prospectus last week, but the initial filing only included the company's financials through the first half of the year.
Equities.reason: Major AI company filing showing very large revenue/commitments; supports the long-term AI growth narrative and capital markets activity around AI, but relevance is limited relative to prevailing near-term risk-off themes.

Rates.title: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
Rates.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia's decision was in line with expectations from economists polled by Reuters, and marked its fifth rate increase this year.
Rates.reason: Direct central-bank rate hike to an 18-year high. Clear tightening impulse -> upward pressure on yields (negative for bond prices). Important regional policy move that reinforces global 'higher-for-longer' narrative.

Rates.title: Bullock Speech: RBA Governor speaks on policy outlook after the expected interest rate hike
Rates.summary: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock is addressing the press conference, explaining the reason behind raising the key interest rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 4.85% from 4.60% in the November policy meeting.
Rates.reason: Policy communication accompanying the RBA hike. Reinforces tightening rationale and near-term yield repricing in Australian rates markets; smaller relevance than the policy decision itself.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Core monetary policy communication from the Fed. In the prevailing macro regime (sticky inflation/higher-for-longer), the FOMC statement tends to support higher-for-longer pricing, pressuring bond prices and lifting yields.

Rates.title: Fed will vote on rates less often. What that could mean for borrowers
Rates.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said he plans to reduce the number of rate-setting votes, a move some economists say could delay relief for borrowers.
Rates.reason: Governance change that market commentators interpret as potentially delaying policy shifts (i.e., delaying easing). Small-to-moderate negative implication for bond prices due to possible slower move toward cuts.

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions
Rates.reason: ECB policy communication/decisions are central to euro-area yields. In the current environment, ECB decisions are contributing to a global tightening narrative and continued upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Results of the ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters for the fourth quarter of 2026
Rates.reason: Survey of professional forecasters gives insight into inflation and growth expectations which influence medium-term yield curves. Current signals bolster the higher-for-longer case, though impact is more gradual.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (October-December 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: Operational schedule for JGB outright purchases directly affects JGB supply/demand and yields. Active purchase schedules are supportive for bond prices (downward pressure on yields) and thus counterbalance global tightening forces.

Rates.title: (Reference) Outlook Report and Indicators Related to Underlying Inflation
Rates.reason: Inflation-related indicators from the BOJ feed into expectations for future policy and JGB yields. Current indicators tilt towards stickier inflation, modestly pressuring yields higher.

Rates.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened
Rates.reason: Tightening lending conditions signal a restrictive financial backdrop and reinforce central-bank caution; implies slower easing and upward pressure on yields across credit and sovereign markets.

Rates.title: I bonds now pay 5.51% — but there are trade-offs. What to know before buying
Rates.summary: I bonds are now paying 5.51%. Here are some key things to know before investing, according to financial experts.
Rates.reason: Elevated retail Treasury-like yields (I bonds) can influence investor demand dynamics for nominal Treasuries, modestly pressuring benchmark yields. Impact is limited and more tactical than structural.

Rates.title: Credit pressures test bond rally as inflation complicates Fed policy outlook
Rates.reason: Headline points to stress on a recent bond rally and that sticky inflation complicates Fed policy — a direct encapsulation of the tension pushing yields higher and increasing rate volatility.

Rates.title: Remit for the Monetary Policy Committee - October 2026
Rates.summary: Letter from the Chancellor to the Governor
Rates.reason: Official remit shapes the MPC's mandate and market expectations for UK policy. In the current global tightening context, this supports a cautious/hawkish UK policy stance and upward pressure on gilt yields.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar regains lost ground amid higher Oil prices, US midterm elections
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) is taking back some losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, favoured by a moderate rebound in Crude prices, as the US resumed hostilities in Iran.
FX.reason: Oil-driven CAD strength and geopolitically-driven risk-on/support for commodity FX; directly impacts CAD/USD and is timely around midterm-driven flows.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains further against US Dollar as oil prices correct sharply
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its winning streak against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Tuesday. As of writing, the USD/INR pair is down 0.15% to near 94.83.
FX.reason: INR strength vs USD on lower oil is a local EMFX flow—relevant for USD/EM pairs but smaller market footprint than majors.

FX.title: US Dollar: Election risks and tighter liquidity ahead - Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team highlights that US midterm elections are held today, with tentative results due Wednesday and final outcomes potentially taking weeks. Prediction markets currently favor Democrats for the House and give them a strong chance in the Senate.
FX.reason: Midterm-driven election risk and potential liquidity tightening are material for USD direction; implies dollar downside (positive for non-USD currencies) with high relevance.

FX.title: Euro edges up against US Dollar in countdown to US Midterm elections
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally higher at around 1.1195 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The EUR/USD pair ticks up as the US Dollar is under pressure amid caution ahead of United States (US) Midterm elections later i
FX.reason: EUR/USD uptick tied to election-related USD weakness—major-pair move with direct USD transmission and medium relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds steady near 102.00 ahead of US midterm elections
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding its position after registering modest losses in the previous day and trading near 101.80 during Asian hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: DXY stability near 102 suggests limited dollar follow-through intraday; small influence on near-term FX flows.

FX.title: Forex Today: No signs of Dollar strength on US midterm election day
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, November 3:
FX.reason: Explicit FX-market read that USD is not showing strength on a major political event day—clear signal for broader non-USD appreciation; high relevance for majors.

FX.title: Australian Dollar declines after RBA hikes rates by 25 bps to 4.85%
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) faces selling pressure against its peers after the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) interest rate decision. Against the US Dollar (USD), the Australian currency is down 0.25% to near 0.6975.
FX.reason: AUD weakness versus USD despite a rate hike—important central-bank-driven idiosyncrasy that weighs on AUD/USD and commodity‑FX flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: RBA pause may weigh on AUD into year-end - TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities’ Prashant Newnaha sees the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) 25bp hike to 4.85%, its highest rate since 2008, as a conditional pause rather than the start of another tightening cycle.
FX.reason: Analyst view that the RBA’s move is effectively a pause supports medium-term AUD downside vs USD; relevant but not as market-moving as the decision itself.

FX.title: China to raise forex deposit reserve ratio to 6% starting November 15
FX.reason: Policy tightening via higher FX deposit reserve ratio is a material PBOC step to cool yuan appreciation—likely to weigh on CNY (i.e., relative USD strength) with high market relevance.

FX.title: China Vows to Boost Yuan Liquidity, Back Hong Kong Markets
FX.reason: Official assurances to back liquidity and Hong Kong markets are a modest supportive signal for the yuan; partially offsets tightening rhetoric but lower relevance than the policy move.

Commodities.title: Gold drops to $3,900 as bears shrug off softer USD amid Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its intraday slide through the early European session on Tuesday, dropping to the $3,900 neighborhood in the last hour amid bets for further tightening by the US Federal Reserve (Fed).
Commodities.reason: Fed rate-hike expectations are a key downward driver for gold; article signals ongoing pressure on prices (moderate-high relevance).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD seems vulnerable near YTD low, as bears await $49.00 break
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) comes under renewed selling pressure on Tuesday, reversing the previous day's goodish recovery gains and dropping back closer to its lowest level since November 2025, touched last week.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-pressure piece showing renewed selling; relevant to silver price momentum but mainly short-term/technical.

Commodities.title: Central Banks Buy Gold at Fastest Pace Since 2024, WGC Says
Commodities.reason: Material, structural demand from official buyers is a strong bullish driver for gold prices and market positioning (high relevance).

Commodities.title: Natural gas: Shipping channel drives gas volatility – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale analysts Michael Haigh and Jeremy Sellem argue that LNG shipping conditions are central to how maritime risk transmits into natural gas volatility. As Europe relies more on LNG imports and the United States on exports, freight costs, inventory
Commodities.reason: Highlights shipping/freight as a volatility and risk-premium channel for gas prices; directional impact ambiguous so low positive score for increased risk-premium/volatility.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Clings to modest gains above $96.00 as US-Iran peace hopes cap upside
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts some dip-buyers during the Asian session on Tuesday, reversing a part of the previous day's heavy losses to the $94.30 area, or an over two-week low.
Commodities.reason: Article frames oil as capped by diplomatic/peace hopes — net negative for near-term WTI upside but limited by dip-buying (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Near-term supply disruption risk from Gulf production shut-ins supports higher oil/natural gas prices (clear, regionally significant supply shock).

Commodities.title: Middle East Oil Markets Flash Signs of Abundance as Flows Rise
Commodities.reason: Rising flows/abundance from the Middle East materially reduce risk premia in oil markets — important bearish structural signal for crude (high relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil rises as peace prospects dim after US hits Iran’s Qeshm Island
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation increases oil risk-premium and pushes prices higher; included as a shorter-term counter to diplomatic easing stories (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil prices steady at $106 after sharp declines
Commodities.summary: Crude prices stabilise on Tuesday as traders await developments in the Middle East
Commodities.reason: Stabilisation after a fall reflects lower near-term conviction and ongoing geopolitics; mildly bearish/taking-off downside momentum (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Biggest Jump in Two Months on Iran Peace-Deal Hopes
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical peace hopes can lift risk sentiment and safe-haven flows into gold in the short term; meaningful but balanced by rate-driven headwinds.

Commodities.title: Gold: Recovery from one-year low remains fragile – ING
Commodities.summary: ING commodities strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey say Gold rebounded 1.85% after last week’s sharp sell-off, helped by lower Oil prices and bargain hunting.
Commodities.reason: Notes a fragile rebound driven by bargain-hunting and commodity cross-links (oil); soft bullish signal but limited by fragility and macro rates.

Commodities.title: India’s Tax Hike Drives Illegal Gold Imports to Three-Year High
Commodities.reason: Indicates persistent retail/physical demand dynamics in a major market (India); supports baseline demand but is more structural/market-structure than immediate price driver.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $50.50 as US attacks on Iran’s Qeshm Island
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around $50.30 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Price action shows renewed weakness despite geopolitical noise; medium relevance for silver market momentum.

Commodities.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
Commodities.reason: Small-scale tokenisation/infrastructure story that marginally improves copper market liquidity/availability — limited near-term price impact.

Commodities.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
Commodities.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation.
Commodities.reason: Rising LNG import dependence and potential seasonal demand upside support regional natural gas prices (clear demand-side signal).

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
Crypto.reason: Material ETF outflows are a direct demand shock for liquid BTC products and signal near-term selling/weak institutional demand — negative for price and market sentiment.

Crypto.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
Crypto.reason: Exchange tapping SAFU at scale materially reduces a key safety buffer and raises counterparty/liquidity risk perceptions — significant negative for crypto markets and confidence in major exchange custodial resilience.

Crypto.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level or governance-led recovery of stolen funds is a constructive precedent for chain-level remediation and reduces net loss from the hack — modestly positive for risk appetite in on-chain ecosystems.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
Crypto.reason: Price weakness tied to broader equity/chip sell-off and political event risk shows crypto's continued sensitivity to macro/risk-off moves — negative for near-term returns.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
Crypto.reason: Significant exchange outflows can remove available sell-side liquidity and create a near-term supply squeeze; market positioning around macro events could amplify a post-election rally — constructive short-term supply signal.

Crypto.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
Crypto.reason: Another exchange-level theft and withdrawal halt materially increases regional counterparty risk and reduces user confidence — negative for crypto sentiment and flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
Crypto.reason: Large customer withdrawals reflect flight-to-safety/custody migration; while off-exchange balances can be bullish longer-term (less sell liquidity), the immediate context shows price easing and elevated uncertainty — modestly negative near-term.

Crypto.title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: The piece aggregates near-term catalysts (hack fallout + macro events) that frame direction; useful for positioning but lower incremental signal on its own.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounce fades as Binance exploit, AI unwind continue to weigh
Crypto.reason: Ongoing reporting of exploit-driven outflows and sector deleveraging sustains negative market momentum and higher volatility — meaningful negative signal for near-term crypto flows.

Crypto.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
Crypto.reason: Another sizable suspected loss tied to exchange accounts reinforces the theme of security breaches and counterparty risk in the current episode — negative for market confidence.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
Crypto.reason: Institutional rollout of tokenized deposits is incremental adoption of token-based financial infrastructure — constructive for long-term institutionalization of crypto-related rails.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level patching of a potential minting flaw reduces systemic risk for that ledger and improves trust in protocol maintenance — small positive for that ecosystem and broader on-chain confidence.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
Crypto.reason: Higher near-term implied volatility tied to political events is an expected market condition; it raises hedging costs and may deter marginal risk-taking — small negative for risk-sensitive flows.
